name: A Fishy Peril
summary: In eastern Elwynn, Remy "Two Times" fears a danger is spreading. Fishing has suffered and travelers face attacks, but he doubts the guard understands the trouble.

sections.title: A Plea from the East
sections.body: In Goldshire seeking business, Remy grows uneasy as murlocs swim up streams and into inland shallows. He asks passersby to warn the township before the threat spreads further.

sections.title: A Strained Garrison
sections.body: Marshal Dughan hears the report but doubts it. His garrison is stretched thin, and without confirmed intelligence, he will not send scarce men after rumors of fish-men in the eastern streams.

faq.q: Who gives the quest A Fishy Peril?
faq.answer: Remy "Two Times", a merchant from Redridge, asks you to carry his warning in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Why is Remy "Two Times" worried about murlocs?
faq.answer: Remy has seen murlocs swim up the rivers of eastern Elwynn. They drive away local fish and attack travelers along the waterways.

faq.q: Why won't Marshal Dughan send troops immediately?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan considers the reports unverified. His garrison is occupied by gnoll attacks and organized banditry, so he cannot commit soldiers without formal scout reports.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
aliases: what comes after a fishy peril
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan seeks reliable confirmation from scouts in Further Concerns before committing royal resources to the east.

faq.q: Where does the player turn in A Fishy Peril?
faq.answer: You deliver the report to Marshal Dughan just outside the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

faq.q: What larger threat are the murlocs part of in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Murlocs appear primitive and erratic, yet their spread into inland lakes such as Stonecairn Lake and Crystal Lake threatens rural trade and agriculture alongside gnoll and bandit attacks.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this warning shows the strain on Stormwind's home guard and the township's reliance on independent adventurers to investigate rumors.
As a human, you see eastern waterways close to home become dangerous hunting grounds for aquatic beasts.
